{{Quote|This bounty hunter caught up to us. Nasty little Rodian. Before we could draw blasters, the Devaronian cuts a deal. Not only did he buy off the bounty hunter, he convinced him to sell his own starship!|[[Dindo (Human)|Dindo]]|<ref name="TOR:TtS">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Tracking the Smuggler|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Veeboo Lunx]] owned a '''starship''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:TtS" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Veeboo tracked his mark [[Gault Rennow|Tyresius Lokai]] over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] and shot down the fugitive over the desert.<ref name="TOR:TTT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Tatooine Target|the D5-Mantis}}</ref> Eventually, Lokai managed to convince Veeboo to sell him his own ship and let him escape.<ref name="TOR:TtS" />
